entries.title: The race sheet every non-INDY NXT chart dot opens (/career/race/…): clean titles, the field as a picture, the chapter as a labelled chart

values.label: ladder (final pass, default): words, the field as a ladder (P1 at the top, his car rising from grid slot to flag, once), and his chapter side by side; on a phone the ladder lies on its side
row: the field on its side at every width, the chapter chart full width under it

entries.look: Open any non-INDY NXT dot on Career (a chapter strip or the climb). Watch his car move from grid slot to flag; point at (or tap) a dot in the chapter chart to read that race, click to open it. Try Mid-Ohio (track picture), the 2019 Festival Last Chance Race (started behind the classified field), a win (no field size), Daytona (61 cars) and a one-race series (USF Pro 2000: his whole career instead). Back to Career returns to where you clicked.
